        p300.dispense(well_info["step_2_transfer_in_ul"], target_well)

    p300.aspirate(50, tuberack["A3"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["A11"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Sterility control (A12): 100 ul broth
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["A12"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Process row B with antibiotic 2
    for well_info in series_wells:

        p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Remove excess from last well (B10) to waste
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, plate["B10"])
    p300.dispense(50, waste_well)
    p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Growth control (B11): 50 ul broth + 50 ul culture

    p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["B11"])

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "MIC plate for 2 antibiotics",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_racks = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    
    # Load pipette
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_racks])
    
    # Define liquids with display_color
    antibiotic_1 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 1", "Antibiotic 1 stock solution", display_color="#FF0000")
    antibiotic_2 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 2", "Antibiotic 2 stock solution", display_color="#00FF00")
    broth = protocol.define_liquid("broth", "Mueller-Hinton broth", display_color="#0000FF")
    culture = protocol.define_liquid("culture", "Bacterial culture", display_color="#FFFF00")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    tuberack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_1, volume=2000)
    tuberack["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_2, volume=2000)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=broth, volume=2000)
    tuberack["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=culture, volume=2000)
    
    # Waste well for excess
    waste_well = tuberack["A6"]
    
    # Process a row of wells with a given antibiotic source
    def process_row(row_letter, antibiotic_source):
        for col in range(1, 11):  # columns 1 to 10
            target_well = plate["{}{}".format(row_letter, col)]
            # Add 50 ul broth (diluent)
            p300.pick_up_tip()
            p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
            p300.dispense(50, target_well)
            p300.mix(50, repetitions=1)
            p300.drop_tip()
            # Determine source for the antibiotic transfer
            if col == 1:
                source = antibiotic_source
            else:
                source = plate["{}{}".format(row_letter, col-1)]
            # Transfer 50 ul from source into the well
            p300.pick_up_tip()
            p300.aspirate(50, source)
            p300.dispense(50, target_well)
            p300.mix(50, repetitions=1)
            p300.drop_tip()
            # Remove 50 ul from the last well (col 10) to waste
            if col == 10:
                p300.pick_up_tip()
                p300.aspirate(50, target_well)
                p300.dispense(50, waste_well)
                p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Process rows A and B
    process_row("A", tuberack["A1"])
    process_row("B", tuberack["A2"])
    
    # Growth control wells A11 and B11: 50 ul broth + 50 ul culture
    # A11
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["A11"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, tuberack["A3"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["A11"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    # B11
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["B11"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, tuberack["A3"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["B11"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Sterility control wells A12 and B12: 100 ul broth
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["A12"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["B12"])
    p300.drop_tip()"}

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "MIC plate for 2 antibiotics",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_racks = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    
    # Load pipette
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_racks])
    
    # Define liquids with display_color
    antibiotic_1 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 1", "Antibiotic 1 stock solution", display_color="#FF0000")
    antibiotic_2 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 2", "Antibiotic 2 stock solution", display_color="#00FF00")
    broth = protocol.define_liquid("broth", "Mueller-Hinton broth", display_color="#0000FF")
    culture = protocol.define_liquid("culture", "Bacterial culture", display_color="#FFFF00")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    tuberack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_1, volume=2000)
    tuberack["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_2, volume=2000)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=broth, volume=2000)
    tuberack["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=culture, volume=2000)
    
    # Waste well for excess
    waste_well = tuberack["A6"]
    
    # Process a row of wells with a given antibiotic source
    def process_row(row_letter, antibiotic_source):
        for col in range(1, 11):  # columns 1 to 10
            target_well = plate["{}{}".format(row_letter, col)]
            # Add 50 ul broth (diluent)
            p300.pick_up_tip()
            p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
            p300.dispense(50, target_well)
            p300.mix(50)
            p300.drop_tip()
            # Determine source for the antibiotic transfer
            if col == 1:
                source = antibiotic_source
            else:
                source = plate["{}{}".format(row_letter, col-1)]
            # Transfer 50 ul from source into the well
            p300.pick_up_tip()
            p300.aspirate(50, source)
            p300.dispense(50, target_well)
            p300.mix(50)
            p300.drop_tip()
            # Remove 50 ul from the last well (col 10) to waste
            if col == 10:
                p300.pick_up_tip()
                p300.aspirate(50, target_well)
                p300.dispense(50, waste_well)
                p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Process rows A and B
    process_row("A", tuberack["A1"])
    process_row("B", tuberack["A2"])
    
    # Growth control wells A11 and B11: 50 ul broth + 50 ul culture
    # A11
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["A11"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, tuberack["A3"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["A11"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    # B11
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["B11"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(50, tuberack["A3"])
    p300.dispense(50, plate["B11"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Sterility control wells A12 and B12: 100 ul broth
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["A12"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["B12"])
    p300.drop_tip()"}

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "MIC plate for 2 antibiotics",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_racks = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    
    # Load pipette
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_racks])
    
    # Define liquids with display_color
    antibiotic_1 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 1", "Antibiotic 1 stock solution", display_color="#FF0000")
    antibiotic_2 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 2", "Antibiotic 2 stock solution", display_color="#00FF00")
    broth = protocol.define_liquid("broth", "Mueller-Hinton broth", display_color="#0000FF")
    culture = protocol.define_liquid("culture", "Bacterial culture", display_color="#FFFF00")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells (using max well volume ~1898 ul)
    tuberack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_1, volume=1500)
    tuberack["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_2, volume=1500)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=broth, volume=2000)
    tuberack["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=culture, volume=1500)
    
    # Waste well for excess
    waste_well = tuberack["A6"]
    
    # Process a row of wells with a given antibiotic source
    def process_row(row_letter, antibiotic_source):
        for col in range(1, 11):  # columns 1 to 10
            target_well = plate["{}{}".format(row_letter, col)]
            # Add 50 ul broth (diluent)
            p300.pick_up_tip()
            p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
            p300.dispense(50, target_well)
            p300.mix(50, 5)
            p300.drop_tip()
            # Determine source for the antibiotic transfer
            if col == 1:
                source = antibiotic_source
            else:
                source = plate["{}{}".format(row_letter, col-1)]
            # Transfer 50 ul from source into the well
            p300.pick_up_tip()
            p300.aspirate(50, source)
            p300.dispense(50, target_well)
            p300.mix(50, 5)
            p300.drop_tip()
            # Remove 50 ul from the last well (col 10) to waste
            if col == 10:
                p300.pick_up_tip()
                p300.aspirate(50, target_well)
                p300.dispense(50, waste_well)
                p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Process rows A and B
    process_row("A", tuberack["A1"])
    process_row("B", tuberack["A2"])
    
    # Add 50 ul culture to every well in columns 1-11 (including growth control)
    for col in range(1, 12):
        # Add to row A
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(50, tuberack["A3"])
        p300.dispense(50, plate["A" + str(col)])
        p300.drop_tip()
        # Add to row B
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(50, tuberack["A3"])
        p300.dispense(50, plate["B" + str(col)])
        p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Sterility control wells A12 and B12: 100 ul broth
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["A12"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["B12"])
    p300.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "MIC plate for 2 antibiotics",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_racks = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)

    # Define liquids with display_color
    antibiotic_1 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 1", "Antibiotic 1 stock solution", display_color="#FF0000")
    antibiotic_2 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 2", "Antibiotic 2 stock solution", display_color="#00FF00")
    broth = protocol.define_liquid("broth", "Mueller-Hinton broth", display_color="#0000FF")
    culture = protocol.define_liquid("culture", "Bacterial culture", display_color="#FFFF00")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells (using max well volume ~1898 ul)
    tuberack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_1, volume=1500)
    tuberack["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_2, volume=1500)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=broth, volume=2000)
    tuberack["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=culture, volume=1500)
    
    # Waste well for excess
    waste_well = tuberack["A6"]
    
    # Process a row of wells with a given antibiotic source
    def process_row(row_letter, antibiotic_source):
        for col in range(1, 11):  # columns 1 to 10

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "MIC plate for 2 antibiotics",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_racks = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tuberack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    
    # Load pipette
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_racks])
    
    # Define liquids with display_color
    antibiotic_1 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 1", "Antibiotic 1 stock solution", display_color="#FF0000")
    antibiotic_2 = protocol.define_liquid("antibiotic 2", "Antibiotic 2 stock solution", display_color="#00FF00")
    broth = protocol.define_liquid("broth", "Mueller-Hinton broth", display_color="#0000FF")
    culture = protocol.define_liquid("culture", "Bacterial culture", display_color="#FFFF00")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells (using max well volume ~1898 ul)
    tuberack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_1, volume=1500)
    tuberack["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=antibiotic_2, volume=1500)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=broth, volume=2000)
    tuberack["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=culture, volume=1500)
    
    # Waste well for excess
    waste_well = tuberack["A6"]
    
    # Helper function to manually mix a well
    def mix_well(well, volume, cycles):
        for _ in range(cycles):
            p300.pick_up_tip()
            p300.aspirate(volume, well)
            p300.dispense(volume, well)
            p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Process a row of wells with a given antibiotic source
    def process_row(row_letter, antibiotic_source):
        for col in range(1, 11):  # columns 1 to 10
            target_well = plate["{}{}".format(row_letter, col)]
            # Add 50 ul broth (diluent)
            p300.pick_up_tip()
            p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
            p300.dispense(50, target_well)
            p300.drop_tip()
            # Determine source for the antibiotic transfer
            if col == 1:
                source = antibiotic_source
            else:
                source = plate["{}{}".format(row_letter, col-1)]
            # Transfer 50 ul from source into the well
            p300.pick_up_tip()
            p300.aspirate(50, source)
            p300.dispense(50, target_well)
            # Manually mix the well
            mix_well(target_well, 50, 5)
            # Remove 50 ul from the last well (col 10) to waste
            if col == 10:
                p300.pick_up_tip()
                p300.aspirate(50, target_well)
                p300.dispense(50, waste_well)
                p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Process rows A and B
    process_row("A", tuberack["A1"])
    process_row("B", tuberack["A2"])
    
    # Add 50 ul culture to every well in columns 1-11 (including growth control)
    for col in range(1, 12):
        # Add to row A
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(50, tuberack["A3"])
        p300.dispense(50, plate["A" + str(col)])
        p300.drop_tip()
        # Add to row B
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(50, tuberack["A3"])
        p300.dispense(50, plate["B" + str(col)])
        p300.drop_tip()
    
    # Sterility control wells A12 and B12: 100 ul broth
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["A12"])
    p300.drop_tip()
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(100, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(100, plate["B12"])
    p300.drop_tip()"}
